title: Hermeneutics, every hand-checked weight, and whole documents
summary: A guide to reading magisterial texts in ten principles, each grounded in texts of the collection; a list of all the hand-checked weight ranges with their reasons; a view of each document after 1958 as a whole; short links such as ds/3074/ and lg/25/; and a correction to the grade of n. 723a.

title: The Synod of Sutri (1046)
summary: The witnesses to the Synod of Sutri and the deposition of Gregory VI, with a disputed question on whether a synod can judge a pope.

title: Moyses vir Dei, the last bulls of union of Florence, and the confirmation of Trent
summary: Moyses vir Dei in full, the bulls of union with the Syrians and with the Chaldeans and Maronites of Cyprus, and Pius IV's bull confirming the Council of Trent.

title: Ask chooses better texts
summary: Ask and the statement check choose texts by the doctrines a question names and the guides that discuss them, list them with the reason for each, and let the reader add or remove texts before asking.

title: Reading a condemnation
summary: A guide to reading condemned propositions in the sense they were condemned, with Unigenitus and ten more cases, and a statement check for any AI client.

title: From 2000 to Leo XIV
summary: John Paul II's last years, Benedict XVI, Francis and Leo XIV to October 2026, one entry per article of each document.

title: Paul VI and John Paul II to 1999
summary: The documents of Paul VI and John Paul II to 1999, the Catechism of the Catholic Church and the documents of other Vatican bodies, labelled by kind and graded by hand.

title: John XXIII and the Second Vatican Council
summary: The documents of John XXIII and the Second Vatican Council, one entry per article, graded by hand.

title: Sources of Catholic Dogma
summary: The reader: Denzinger's Enchiridion in English with the older numbering, DS numbers, the Latin text, hand-checked weights, the Roman Catechism, a timeline, entry pages and open data.
